items.title: 11. Health risk assessment and demography (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 11. Health risk assessment and demography: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 189-189.

blocks.text: Aakhir mein, biostatistics sehat ke khatron ke andaze (health risk assessment) aur demography (aabadi ka ilm) mein ahem hai: yeh paidaish, amwaat, bimari ke aam hone (prevalence) aur doosre vital statistics ke rujhanaat ka analysis karti hai. Is se sarkari idaron aur sehat ki tanzeemon ko khidmaat ki planning, wasail ki taqseem aur public health ke masail hal karne ke liye zaroori maloomat milti hain. Yeh tamam istemal dikhate hain ke duniya bhar mein sehat behtar karne ke liye biostatistics kitni zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Waba (epidemic) ke dauran biostatistics kis tarah madad karti hai? Koi do tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq yeh bimari ke phailao ka peecha karti hai, mortality rate (amwaat ki sharah) ka andaza lagati hai aur khatre wali population pehchanti hai; in fauri nataij se outbreak rokne ke khaas iqdamaat kiye jate hain.

items: Gyarah istemal: clinical trials, epidemiology, genetics, public health policy, environmental health, bioinformatics, quality control, health programmes, wabaon par qaboo, ilaaj ki rukawatein, risk assessment aur demography.
Har jagah biostatistics data se saboot deti hai jis par sehat ke faisle hote hain.
